create_mujoco_profiling_wrapper: create a Wrapper instance that wraps a dm_control environment and adds step timing profile data to observations
reset_wrapped_environment: reset the wrapped environment and return a time step that includes the initial MuJoCo step timing observation
step_wrapped_environment: step the wrapped environment with an action and return a time step augmented with cumulative step timing data
get_observation_spec: get the extended observation spec that includes the original spec plus a step timing array with duration and call count
add_profile_observation: add a MuJoCo step timing observation with duration and timer call count to a time step's observation dictionary
